content.short: Predict.fun is a BNB Chain native prediction market covering politics, sports, and crypto, integrated with Binance Wallet.
content.description: Predict.fun is a decentralized prediction market that launched on Blast and now runs as a BNB Chain native venue, listing markets across politics, sports, crypto, and culture. Users buy and sell outcome shares that settle onchain when an event resolves, with rewards layered on trading activity. Its main distribution advantage is integration with Binance Wallet, which surfaces its markets directly to a very large existing exchange audience, so users never have to find and fund a standalone application first.
